name: Additional Tribute
notes: mayPay player:"opponent" offers the payment only to the one bound opponent. 'Any opponent' means each opponent in turn may pay: re-encode as anyPlayerMayPay restricted to opponents (offer in seat order, first payer pays; the controller is never offered). Also settle who draws ('they' = the payer) since the encoding draws for the controller.

name: Akashic Coin
phrases: enters play under an opponent's control, that player may pay 2
notes: Both triggers use mayPay player:"opponent" for 'that player'. In 3+ players the payer must be the opponent whose card entered, not a freshly bound/prompted opponent: use player {controllerOf eventCard} (as Phantasmagoric Tollbooth does) or auto-bind opponentId to the event player for triggers on an opponent's event.
